notes.title: Update: Flying High!
notes.notes:
Kingpins - put down the clipboard and pick up your aviators, because the skies just opened for business!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39744790/f48183048bcae9c26eddbc8d772c49bb2131ccb3.png[/img]

In our latest update, you can finally do what every enterprising factory tycoon dreams of: buy a sketchy plane and use it to fly your totally legitimate products far, far away!

Preferably to places with loose laws and heavy wallets…

It doesn’t come cheap though, clocking in at a cool $250,000 the plane is the new most expensive item in the game, with an additional $5,000 daily upkeep cost!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39744790/28ca36ada84e530c569dcba52fc4ea125f6cced2.png[/img]

The plane can be purchased within the usual build menu. Naturally, the runway is quite large occupying 4x2 sub-plots of space on your factory plot, but the investment is worth it!

Once you’ve selected the perfect location for your runway you will be able to generate and fulfill lucrative international orders!

Keep it shady, air barons.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39744790/d3e51e580d165a25c9b18025578915d1813386d8.png[/img]

Other Notes:
Fixed a bug where AOE values (e.g. light and heat) could be incorrectly set when demolishing / building over rooms containing AOE emitters.
Increased the minimum order times to 6 minutes for special client deliveries.

notes.title: Patch #22: Just One More Patch – (Spoiler: It’s Never Just One)
notes.notes:
Hello hello, we've got some fixes and qol changes here from a game that isn't taking legal action against anyone!

Bug Fixes:
[list]
[*] Delivery vehicles sometimes driving past an open parking bay and instead circling the block.
[*] The Garage UI not updating properly after changes are made to the products delivered by that garage / vehicle.
[*] Products stuck on the ground will be despawned after 5 minutes.
[*] The time speed was not being taken into account during cleaning tasks, meaning cleaning up a product at x3 speed took the same amount of time as cleaning up a product at x1 speed.
[*] If a garage was deleted, the next garage would inherit the previously deleted garage’s sorting color and some other additional settings.
[*] Garages’ order (within the garage’s list to the left of the dispatch map) could change after saving and reloading the game. They are now ordered consistently.
[*] Removed a parking spot from Seal Avenue which workers were unable to collect products from.
[*] Pressing esc during room construction / deletion would cause the build cost / space indicators to be stuck on screen.
[/list]

QOL:
[list]
[*] Garages are now sorted by oldest to newest. If the sorting color of a garage is changed it will go to the bottom of the list for its new sorting color.
[*] If a delivery destination is removed from a vehicle whilst it is parked there, it will leave to go to the next destination.
[*] Play an animation on a newly hired employee within the list & also when an employee’s sorting color is changed to highlight the new / modified employee.
[/list]

Tutorial Bug Fixes:
[list]
[*] Tutorial landscaping objects were not spawning when starting a new game.
[*] Tutorial door placement indicators remaining in place even after placing a door in the correct position.
[*] Saving and reloading the game multiple times during the tutorial would cause the in-world tutorial indicators (e.g. the arrows above employees) to either not display or be positioned incorrectly.

[*] In-world green tutorial indicators would remain in place even if the applicable object’s placement was cancelled.
[*] When cancelling the placement of a tutorial object, the button indicating that the object needed to be placed would stop animating unless the menu was closed and reopened.
[*] The optional tutorial panel was closed if it was open when the player completed the optional tutorial segment.
[/list]

Tutorial Polish:
[list]
[*] During the tutorial, snap objects into place if they are moved into the correct position and rotation.
[*] Remove the green tutorial placement indicators if an object is moved into the correct position and rotation.
[*] Removed objects’ grid occupations indicator for tutorial objects, it’s cleaner just to have the green indicator showing the outline of the object.

notes.title: Patch #21: Keeping you coming back for more
notes.notes:
Greetings Kingpins!

We've been in the lab and here's an assortment of user interface changes and bug fixes!

[h3]New Employee Management setting[/h3]
[list]
[*] A button to re-hire dead employee's has been added. When your employees die, a button will be appear in their place, allowing you to replace their feeble entity with a new employee with the same equipment, room group, schedule and task settings. If you do not want to re-hire them, you can dismiss them.
[*] A button to duplicate employee settings. Once you've hired an employee with their tasks, equipment and room, there is now a button to duplicate them with all of their settings!
[/list]

[h3]Save Backup system[/h3]
[list]
[*] Your ten most recent saves for a game will now be retained.
[*] The load menu will show the most recent save by default
[*] When deleting saves, you can choose to delete an individual save, or all instances of a world and game.
[/list]

[h3]Qol Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Area of Effect emitters  such as heaters will now be removed if a new room group is painted over them, previously only objects that belonged in the room would be removed. 
[*] A tooltip appears when hovering over product logos on the dispatch map. 
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Employees' positions within the employee list are now consistent. Newly hired employees will go to the bottom of the list. When an employee’s sorting colour is changed, they will go to the bottom of that sorting colour's list.
[*] Employees were sometimes not properly appearing within the list if they were at the top or bottom of the viewable area of the list.
[*] If a plot business types was changed, the finance panel would only display the new plot type's finance even when viewing previous days' income which would result in a mismatch.
[*] Time speed was not affecting characters' needs depletion, now when playing at the respective speeds, the needs will deplete correctly.
[*] Made load game UI larger to accommodate for certain localisations that were previously cut off.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes #11: Patrolling and catchin' you riding dirty
notes.notes:
They see you rollin' (fat blunts). 

Hello, law-abiding CEOs this patch brings you the ability for your guards to patrol! 

[u]This feature has been added ahead of the upcoming raid update that will be coming soon![/u]
We wanted to give CEOs a chance to set up patrols ahead of this update, in a timely manner before the scourge of the city starts trying to tear down your good, honest work. 

[h1]New Feature:[/h1]
Patrols have been introduced for guards! 

You can create patrol routes, either back and forth or in a loop layout then assign guards to patrol on them during work hours. 

During an attack or emergency, a guard may leave their patrol route to react to these situations.

The first hit's free...and the second....and the third! We've got a big batch of performance improvements in this patch that are going to make the game more stable, faster, and lighter, something that is going to affect every dealer! 

[b][u]Here's what we're addressing this round of hotfixes![/u][/b]

[list]
[*] Faster and more reliable saving and loading. 

[*] Steam achievements have been added!

[*] Cloudy meth is now boxed by employees assigned to Cloudy Meth as opposed to employees who were assigned to deliveries.

[*] Fixed an issue regarding cash registers not being used by customers even though no customer was being served. 

[*] Fixed an issue where delivery vehicles would get stuck on roads.

[/list]

[b]As a reminder: Here is how to backup your save:[/b]

Go to;
steamlibrary>Steamapps>common>dopeloop>dnfc_data>streamingassets>facilitydata
and saving the BYTES file in a folder.

If you want to know what's on our radar to fix, check out [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1036240/Definitely_Not_Fried_Chicken/1/]this thread![/url], We're still working on the issues here

We'll continue dealing out fixes as we work our way through to 1.0!
Thank you all for your support!

notes.title: Hotfix #2
notes.notes:
What do Fried-Chicken and hard drugs have in common? Honestly, a lot more than you'd think, but this was just a snappy tagline to get you to read this round of bug fixes!

[u]Starting with;[/u]
[list]
[*] Loading time has been optimized with an expected reduction of 50% to most players. 
[*] Fixed an issue where having the character's items panel whilst saving would corrupt saves.
[*] Fixed a memory leak where using a heat map overlay in certain conditions would result in a memory leak.
[*] Fixed a (hilarious) issue where the game could not be saved because an employee was stuck attacking the air. 
[*] Various runtime optimizations. 
[/list]

[u]And these are the list of updates making it in from the beta branch![/u]
[list]
[*] Auto-save has been implemented (save frequency is in the Graphics Settings has a default of 5 minutes, though this can be changed).

[*] The issue causing saves getting stuck at 75% has been fixed, however people with those saves need to start a new one.

[*] Employees will not work on products which you don't have the necessary business license for. (Your employees can finally work a donut shop properly!)

[*] UI updated to make it clearer that you need to upgrade the your business license to produce certain products.
[/list]

[b]As a reminder: Here is how to backup your save:[/b]

Go to;
steamlibrary>Steamapps>common>dopeloop>dnfc_data>streamingassets>facilitydata
and saving the BYTES file in a folder.

If you want to know what's on our radar to fix, check out [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1036240/Definitely_Not_Fried_Chicken/1/]this thread![/url], We're still working on the issues here!



We'll continue dealing out fixes as we work our way through to 1.0!
Thank you all for your support!

notes.title: Hotfix 006
notes.notes:
Good morning Corporate Chemists,

[b]AI Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Workers not serving customers at the cash register properly.
[*] If a customer's preferred drug is out of stock, workers will no longer offer another drug which is also out of stock.
[*] Products not made in equal numbers (e.g. not making all kinds of donuts despite having the equipment and workers to do so).
[*] Characters getting stuck on their way to and from business plots.
[*] Characters getting stuck in the same place in an idle loop, even with work to do.
[*] Characters getting stuck when moving from the head of the queue to start using an appliance.
[*] Various additional fail safes for general AI issues.
[*] Vehicles not being able to navigate to the Robot Factory to deliver to the workers there.
[*] Cleaners will now clean up soda / drink / laundry detergent products that have been dropped by workers.
[*] Guns would not fire after re-loading the game.
[*] Character death animation would re-play upon re-loading the game (now dead characters will not appear at all upon re-loading).
[*] Under certain circumstances clients would not pick up delivered boxes from vehicles and aimlessly walk around instead.
[/list]

[b]Gameplay Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Not being able to see how many of each drug type has been delivered to an order (you can now select each drug to see how many have been delivered directly on the map).
[*] Drug delivery numbers disappearing when a delivery was made to a separate client.
[*] Players not being able to purchase additional sub-plots, despite having the money to do so.
[*] Character names now do not change upon re-loading the game.
[*] Characters cannot be fired during an attack to stop the attack prematurely.
[*] Attacks would be skipped if other dialogue was loaded (e.g. tutorial dialogue).
[*] Hotline orders disappearing from the scroll area (to the right of the map) after re-loading a save.
[*] Hitting the spacebar would re-press the most recent button / toggle pressed.
[*] No task description would be shown for cleaners and engineers within the employee rows UI.
[*] Removed some 'Translation Key Not Found' error messages.
[/list]

[b]New Features[/b]
[list]
[*] Floors now get dirty as they are walked over, eventually the cleaner will clean them if they get too dirty. Dirty floors lower hygiene level of workers who work around them.
[*] Additional cosmetic doors, including double doors to make businesses look nicer.
[/list]

[b]Balance[/b]
[list]
[*] Now only Cannabis will be served at the Laundromat and Donut Shop. Meth will be served at the Chicken Shop and Lobster Restaurant (coming during early access). Cocaine will be served at the Nightclub and Casino (both coming during early access).
[*] If a customer's preferred drug is out of stock, workers will upsell to the highest value drug (of the same type) which is currently in stock.
[*] Tweaked a few values to lower business running costs.
[/list]

[b]Other[/b]
[list]
[*] More detailed work descriptions for cleaners.
[*] Allowed the sink to be placed in business staff breakout rooms so cups and plates can be washed up rather than always dropped on the floor.
[*] Hotline customer name displayed instead of 'An NPC' when a new hotline order comes in + changed the character icon to be a phone.
[/list]

N.B. You will need to start a new game for the bug fixes to take effect.

- Nick.
